title: Checkup on everything the voice sessions started

chat.text: The owner asked for a fresh mastermind per task the two voice sessions spawned: where each one is, what is open, the next step decided without waiting. Seven checkup masterminds run, one per group: task system and migration, the AI sheet, the live page, sessions and accounting, past work and salvage, refine and voice, Servex. Each posts its findings here.

message.text: Past-work checkup started: checking the Sessions page finder for the tagged digests, the Whisper log page, the salvage branches, and writing the finding-past-work note.

Starting the task-system checkup: I'm checking the 17-step build against the code, telling the migration agent to do the real run once its dry run checks out, getting the task watcher started, and designing node-driven task templates. The report will be at checkup-task-system/checkup.md.

Started the /live checkup. The card UI, feed, Today card and pointers all landed on dev; I'm now building the /live/archive/ page (old cards moved there by script, reversible) and making the Now card a view of live data.

AI sheet checkup started. Decided the one open question: the sheet is routed at <path>/ai/ (your words), the same way every page already gets md/ and fs/, and a page's real ai child wins. Next: hand mastermind-sheet the go to build steps 2 onward, one commit each, checked at phone and desktop widths.
